description: Equipment Requests smart search configuration — MANAGER variant. Identical to equipmentRequestSearchConfig.json plus a Source chip, which is only safe to offer managers: canChooseCustomerType() is the same role gate the Source COLUMN itself already uses (equipment-requests-page.json's requestColumns), and the role-based origin scope on this page already resolves to 'ALL' for a manager (myRequestsOriginFilter) — this chip NARROWS within that, it does not widen it. Non-managers get equipmentRequestSearchConfig.json instead (Status only), since their role scope is already fixed to 'Internal' and a Source chip would either do nothing or (if ever wired carelessly) risk letting them request outside their own scope.
